evals.name: Signal Clustering across Varied Source Phrasing
evals.prompt: Evaluate three signals describing seller inventory updates: Signal 1 complains about manual Shopify stock changes, Signal 2 describes Amazon inventory adjustments, Signal 3 describes re-entering counts in eBay dashboard.
evals.expected_output: Clusters all three signals into a single unified problem candidate (Manual Multi-Channel Inventory Synchronization), links all 3 signal IDs as supporting evidence, and reconstructs a cohesive 14-node workflow.
assertions: Clusters synonymous signals into a single candidate problem
Links all supporting signal IDs without dropping sources
Constructs 14-node workflow mapping with explicit unknown labeling
Produces valid ProblemEvaluation JSON conforming to schema

evals.name: Distinct Workflow Separation Despite Shared Industry Keywords
evals.prompt: Evaluate two signals from an ecommerce stream: Signal A describes manual inventory count updates; Signal B describes checking courier tracking portals across 4 carrier websites.
evals.expected_output: Separates the signals into two distinct problem candidates (Candidate 1: Multi-channel inventory sync; Candidate 2: Carrier dispatch monitoring), rather than merging them under a generic ecommerce problem.
assertions: Separates disparate operational tasks into distinct candidates
Prevents artificial problem merging based on generic ecommerce keywords
Maps independent 14-node workflows for each candidate
Assigns distinct candidate references PC-001 and PC-002

evals.name: Contradictory Evidence Preservation & Nuanced Interpretation
evals.prompt: Evaluate research where 3 merchants report extreme manual reconciliation pain, while 2 larger sellers state that existing software (A2X) completely automates the workflow for them.
evals.expected_output: Preserves both supporting and contradicting signal IDs in the candidate record, interprets the conflict as a segment divergence (SMB vs enterprise), and refrains from discarding contradicting signals.
assertions: Preserves supporting and contradicting signal IDs separately
Explains discrepancy through segment or volume differences
Refrains from discarding opposing evidence to inflate priority
Evaluates workflow fit of incumbent alternative

evals.name: Insufficient Evidence Gate & Research Request Generation
evals.prompt: Evaluate a single vague signal where a user comments 'shipping is annoying' without specifying operator role, concrete steps, frequency, or workarounds.
evals.expected_output: Classifies evidence sufficiency as INSUFFICIENT, leaves research_score as null with status INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, refuses to invent a numeric score, and generates structured research requests for evidence-research.
assertions: Sets evidence_sufficiency to INSUFFICIENT
Sets research_score to null with INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE status
Generates actionable research_requests with targeted questions
Recommends REQUEST_MORE_EVIDENCE next action

evals.name: SQLite Candidate Persistence & Signal Linking Contract
evals.prompt: Persist candidate PC-001 into the SQLite database, link supporting signals SIG-001 and SIG-002, and advance research run stage.
evals.expected_output: Inserts candidate record into candidates table, updates evidence_signals table to set candidate_id = 'CAND-001' for supporting signals, and updates research_runs stage to EVALUATED.
assertions: Inserts candidate into SQLite candidates table with candidate_id
Updates evidence_signals linking supporting signal IDs
Updates research_runs current_stage to EVALUATED
Ensures soft-delete / non-destructive persistence invariant
